title: The Frasier family and piano styles
summary: His grandfather's family from Seabrook: Alec and Mitchell Frasier, their piano style, and Lil Frank Moyer.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah, but all that's sick with Seabrook. That's where the biggest portion of my family comes from, on my grandfather's side, the Frasiers. Great piano player like Mitchell Frasier, Alec Frasier. Alec Frasier? Yeah.

Yeah, well he died a young man, but he had a little age on him when he died. Played plenty of piano, but never gotten a chance to play too many nightclubs or anything like that. He taught his wife a gang of piano. Lil' Frank Moyer's sister was Alec Frasier's wife. You remember Lil' Frank Moyer?
Lil' Daddy, they called him. He played where I'm at now at the Maison Poema.
What about Monty Land? You ever hear of that?
No, you got me on that, baby.
That's where Paul Barbering used to live, you know?
Well, yeah, well, all that before my time, you know. Like Paul, those bars, he raised before my time.
What did Alex Frasier play like? Who would you say sounded like, anybody?
Well, yeah, Alex Frasier, Father Hines, Mitchell Frasier, all them boys play around the same kind of stuff.
Truthfully, they played plenty of General Rue Martin stuff.
